headline: Back to school: students all-in, educators uneasy
digest: KPMG found 75% of students use generative AI for schoolwork and 59% of educators feel the system is not preparing them. CTV/CP reported calls for unified classroom AI policy. Mila showcased Indigenous Pathfinders prototypes in language, health, education and data sovereignty, and a CSPC editorial urged AI for All to channel funding and procurement to Indigenous-led AI. SRI named AI-literacy scholar Kaitlyn Regehr to lead work on AI's impact on children.
